narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>Twenty five grams is zero point two five kilograms.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>But zero point two five is twenty five hundredths of a kilogram.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>That is two hundred and fifty grams, the pepper packet, not the cardamom.

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>To change grams into kilograms, write the grams over one thousand.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Then read the thousandths as a decimal, with the last digit in the thousandths place.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Your turn. Write seventy five grams and four hundred grams in kilograms.
